title: Internal Routing Form (IRF) — Page 1 (image transcription)
content:
[IMAGE TRANSCRIPTION] This document is a verbatim transcription of an IMAGE, not of page text. The image is page 1 of the blank Internal Routing Form (IRF), version MSU-IRF-Sept. 4, 2024 (alt text: MSU Internal Routing Form page 1). It is published as https://www.morgan.edu/Images/ADMINISTRATION/OFFICES/ora/IRF/IRFp1.png and appears on https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/pre-award/internal-routing-form. The text below was read off the image by machine vision and is reproduced as it appears, including its field labels, section numbering and blank entry fields; anything unreadable is marked [unreadable]. Nothing here is summarized or inferred.

STATE UNIVERSITY
INTERNAL ROUTING FORM
For Internal Use Only

The purpose of this form is to ensure that Morgan State University administrators are aware of the grant requirements (e.g., release

(Word document) to DESHUN.LI@MORGAN.EDU.
Samples available on the ORA website.
